title: Resident Evil 5 Gold Edition (PS3, NTSC-U, app 01.01)
notes: MT Framework: every manager is a singleton whose instance pointer sits beside its class descriptor (MtDTI) in .bss; an object's class is the name its vtable's getDTI (slot 5) returns (MtDTI +4).
Found live 2026-10-20 on the Spark's scratch RPCS3 (arm64 0.0.43) running BLUS30491 with the disc's 01.01 patch, in The Mercenaries Reunion (Public Assembly, Chris Heavy Metal).

Enemy objects (the pointers in enemy.ptrs; uEm10 / uEm11 Majini ...): +0x30 f32 x3 position, +0x40 f32 x4 rotation quaternion, +0x14A4 s16 health, +0x14A6 s16 maximum (Majini 800 / 700; crows uEm62 have 1).
World units are centimetres; heading = 2 atan2(qy, qw) of the quaternion, the atan2(dx, dz) convention (forward = (sin, 0, cos)).

Type D controls (the game's default here): left stick moves / strafes, right stick turns (left = larger heading) and while aiming raises / lowers the aim (up = up), L1 aims, L1 + R1 fires, L2 + R1 knife, up + cross runs.
